unsubscribe.title: One-click processing p95
unsubscribe.honorWindow: Yahoo and Google expect unsubscribe requests honored within 48 hours. Owlat applies the suppression synchronously before recording this sample.

deliverabilityFallbackEditor.escapeHatchHint: Move only an affected destination-provider slice off owned IPs. The sending domain must be currently verified for the relay; credentials alone never count.
deliverabilityFallbackEditor.noRelayEnabled: Enable a relay above first — the escape hatch needs somewhere to move traffic to, and your own MTA is what it moves traffic away from.
deliverabilityFallbackEditor.relayHint: Any enabled relay can be the escape hatch. Saving starts identity provisioning for that relay on every verified owned-MTA domain, but fallback cannot activate until each domain's DNS and provider status are verified — credentials alone never count. Publish the single merged apex SPF when one is shown; otherwise preserve the reviewed manual primary SPF. Never add a second SPF record.
deliverabilityFallbackEditor.warmupOverflowLabel: Send overflow above the owned-IP warming cap through this relay. Owned-IP counters and caps remain unchanged.

deliverabilityLoopbackCard.intro: This sends through the real outbound route to Owlat’s probe mailbox. It reports authorization, signature, alignment, TLS, and the server address observed on arrival.
deliverabilityLoopbackCard.lockedDefaultReason: The loopback proof unlocks after the server identity and required domain checks pass.
